description: Best-price token swap on one EVM chain (KyberSwap aggregator) or cross-chain bridge (LI.FI, fallback Relay; set toChain). Returns expected and minimum output, price impact, gas, every fee (MoneyTools fee: 0.25% on same-chain swaps, disclosed), safety warnings, and an UNSIGNED transaction (plus exact-amount ERC-20 approval) for your own wallet to sign. Free. Never signs or holds funds.

allowHighImpact.description: Return the transaction even if impact exceeds maxPriceImpactPct

amount.description: Amount to sell in human units, e.g. "10" (known symbols only)

amountBaseUnits.description: Amount in token base units (integer). Required for custom token addresses.

chain.description: Source chain: ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche (or chain id)

fromToken.description: Token to sell: symbol (USDC, USDT, ETH, WETH, DAI, ...) or 0x address

maxPriceImpactPct.description: Withhold the transaction if estimated price impact/value loss exceeds this percent

recipient.description: Receiver of the output (defaults to taker)

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (50 = 0.5%, hard cap 300)

taker.description: Your wallet address (0x...). Needed to get an unsigned transaction; omit for a price-only quote.

toChain.description: Destination chain for a cross-chain bridge. Omit for a same-chain swap.

toToken.description: Token to buy: symbol or 0x address (on toChain if bridging)

name: swap_quote
title: Token swap / bridge quote (non-custodial)
